item.text: This survey has survivorship bias: people who found the event too long may have left early and are excluded. Those who remained are more likely to have tolerated or enjoyed its length, so their responses may overstate how appropriate the duration was. The results therefore cannot represent all attendees. To reduce this bias, survey everyone who registered or attended, including those who departed before the event ended.
